stemBlocks: A ray of light is directed into a semicircular transparent block, entering at P. The direction of the ray is adjusted until it strikes the centre of the flat face XY of the block at the critical angle and reflects to Q as shown.

The length of XY is $L$.
The speed of light in air is $c$.
What is the time taken by the light to travel from P to Q in the block?

assets.alt: A semicircular transparent block with a flat face XY. A ray of light enters at P, strikes the center of XY at the critical angle, and reflects to Q. Angles of 60 degrees and 30 degrees are shown relative to the normal and the flat face, respectively.
